description: This file contains benchmark tests for various string and number conversion functions in the Abseil C++ library, including integer to buffer conversions, string to number conversions, and floating-point parsing.

methods.name: BM_FastIntToBuffer
methods.description: Benchmark for converting integers to buffer using FastIntToBuffer.

methods.name: RepeatedSevens
methods.description: Generates an integer with repeated 7s in a given base.

methods.name: BM_safe_strto32_string
methods.description: Benchmark for safe string to int32 conversion.

methods.name: BM_safe_strto64_string
methods.description: Benchmark for safe string to int64 conversion.

methods.name: BM_safe_strtou32_string
methods.description: Benchmark for safe string to uint32 conversion.

methods.name: BM_safe_strtou64_string
methods.description: Benchmark for safe string to uint64 conversion.

methods.name: MakeFloatStrings
methods.description: Creates a vector of strings representing floating point numbers.

methods.name: GetStringAs
methods.description: Converts std::string to specified string type.

methods.name: GetStringsAs
methods.description: Converts a vector of std::string to a vector of specified string type.

methods.name: BM_SimpleAtof
methods.description: Benchmark for converting strings to float using absl::SimpleAtof.

methods.name: BM_SimpleAtod
methods.description: Benchmark for converting strings to double using absl::SimpleAtod.

methods.name: BM_FastHexToBufferZeroPad16
methods.description: Benchmark for converting uint64_t to hex buffer with zero padding.
